sloka: हत्वा त्रिशिरसम् च अपि निर्भया दण्डकाः कृताः ।पित्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन स भार्यः क्षीण जीवितः ॥३-३६-१०॥
transliteration: hatvā triśirasam ca api nirbhayā daṇḍakāḥ kṛtāḥ ।pitrā nirastaḥ kruddhena sa bhāryaḥ kṣīṇa jīvitaḥ ॥3-36-10॥

translations.english: Rama, a victim of his father's anger, banished into the forest with his wife, a shortlived mortal and a calumny on the kshatriyas has killed the army of demons.
